pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surah? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Selected Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Surah.
   C. Say Selected Surah has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Selected Surah to insult classmates of other faiths.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources.

3. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

4. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Purity of Actions? (1 mark)
   A. Use Hadith on Purity of Actions to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Hadith on Purity of Actions has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Purity of Actions with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Purity of Actions.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on dressing? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on dressing.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on dressing with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Hadith on dressing has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Hadith on dressing to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on planting? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hadith on planting with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on planting.
   C. Use Hadith on planting to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Hadith on planting has no place in daily life.

7. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

8. Which response best shows understanding of Twahara? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Twahara.
   B. Apply the teaching of Twahara with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Twahara to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Twahara has no place in daily life.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Tawakkul? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Tawakkul with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Tawakkul has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Tawakkul.
   D. Use Tawakkul to insult classmates of other faiths.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Taqwa? (1 mark)
   A. Use Taqwa to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Taqwa.
   C. Apply the teaching of Taqwa with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Taqwa has no place in daily life.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Zakat:? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Zakat:.
   B. Use Zakat: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Zakat: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Zakat: has no place in daily life.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Stories of Prophets:? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Stories of Prophets: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Stories of Prophets:.
   C. Use Stories of Prophets: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Stories of Prophets: has no place in daily life.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain The Battles of Badr and Uhud and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Treaty of Hudaybiya 03 7.3 Conquest of Makkah 07 7.4 Farewell Pilgrimage 03 Tota and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain The Treaty of Hudaibiya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain The Conquest of Makkah Hunayn and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. A — Apply the teaching of Selected Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. C — Apply the teaching of Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. A — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

4. C — Apply the teaching of Hadith on Purity of Actions with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. B — Apply the teaching of Hadith on dressing with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. A — Apply the teaching of Hadith on planting with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. C — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

8. B — Apply the teaching of Twahara with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. A — Apply the teaching of Tawakkul with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. C — Apply the teaching of Taqwa with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. C — Apply the teaching of Zakat: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. A — Apply the teaching of Stories of Prophets: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of The Battles of Badr and Uhud; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of The Treaty of Hudaibiya; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of The Conquest of Makkah Hunayn; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
